caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a ladder-back design, featuring three curved horizontal slats on the backrest. The chair is composed of cylindrical, spindle-like vertical supports and rungs connecting the legs. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, showing areas of light and shadow for depth. The seat is woven from a light-colored material, with hues of beige and yellow, arranged in a diagonal pattern meeting at the center. The background is plain and uncolored, and the chair is centered within a rectangular border drawn with thin lines, leaving ample blank space around the object.
title: Straw Bottom Chair
